suggest.ext-intl: for Str and Language (advanced unicode manipulation)
suggest.ext-iconv: for Str (converting encoding when ext-mbstring is not available)
suggest.ext-recode: for Str (converting encoding when ext-mbstring and ext-iconv are not available)
suggest.ext-fileinfo: for Io (content type and encoding detection)

scripts.check:pp: @parallel tests:par phpstan:par lint:par phpcs:src-fast phpcs:tests-fast package:check
scripts.tests:par: @parallel x:tests:php85 x:tests:php84 x:tests:php83 x:tests:php82 x:tests:php81 x:tests:php80
scripts.tests:coverage: php vendor/nette/tester/src/tester tests -c tests --colors 1 -p phpdbg --coverage tests/coverage.html --coverage-src src
scripts.phpstan:par: @parallel x:phpstan:php85 x:phpstan:php84 x:phpstan:php83 x:phpstan:php82 x:phpstan:php81 x:phpstan:php80
scripts.x:phpstan:php85: echo PHPStan at PHP 8.5 & php85 vendor/phpstan/phpstan/phpstan analyse --memory-limit 4G -c build/PHPStan/phpstan.php85.neon
scripts.x:phpstan:php84: echo PHPStan at PHP 8.4 & php84 vendor/phpstan/phpstan/phpstan analyse --memory-limit 4G -c build/PHPStan/phpstan.php84.neon
scripts.x:phpstan:php83: echo PHPStan at PHP 8.3 & php83 vendor/phpstan/phpstan/phpstan analyse --memory-limit 4G -c build/PHPStan/phpstan.php83.neon
scripts.x:phpstan:php82: echo PHPStan at PHP 8.2 & php82 vendor/phpstan/phpstan/phpstan analyse --memory-limit 4G -c build/PHPStan/phpstan.php82.neon
scripts.x:phpstan:php81: echo PHPStan at PHP 8.1 & php81 vendor/phpstan/phpstan/phpstan analyse --memory-limit 4G -c build/PHPStan/phpstan.php81.neon
scripts.x:phpstan:php80: echo PHPStan at PHP 8.0 & php80 vendor/phpstan/phpstan/phpstan analyse --memory-limit 4G -c build/PHPStan/phpstan.php80.neon
scripts.lint:par: @parallel x:lint:php85 x:lint:php84 x:lint:php83 x:lint:php82 x:lint:php81 x:lint:php80
scripts.modified-php-src: chmod 777 temp && git diff-index --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR origin/master | grep "^src.*\.php$" > temp/modified-php-src.txt || echo src/loader.php > temp/modified-php-src.txt
scripts.modified-php-tests: chmod 777 temp && git diff-index --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR origin/master | grep "^tests.*\.php$" > temp/modified-php-tests.txt || echo tests/src/bootstrap.php > temp/modified-php-tests.txt
